nativeAudio: actual playing counted; pause/resume and middle start cannot add or bypass an allowance
quota: third pass blocked; teacher grant journaled and permits one more
mobile: counter, time and quota controls fit without horizontal overflow

reload: used and additional listens persist; consumed allowance still blocks playback
retry: new attempt starts at zero and preserves previous listening counts

errors: failure before playing costs no listen; a stall longer than eight seconds exposes retry and retains already consumed listening
solo: quota enforced without teacher grant control
